generated_for: FCR v16 execution scaffold plus clean-room synthetic runs
scope: Machine-readable binding for Paper 6 prediction families PRED-01 through PRED-11 plus explicitly marked external candidate predictions.
status_boundary: This registry is a preregistration scaffold plus internal synthetic pilot ledger. It does not report external adjudication, consciousness, phenomenality, identity transfer, agency, or moral status.
success_metric: A third-party reviewer should be able to design a concrete test or falsification attempt from each record without private explanation from the authors. A reviewer still cannot execute a final preregistered experiment until datasets, seeds, thresholds, exclusion rules, and decision records are frozen.

threshold_policy.rule: Do not invent numeric thresholds. Values are marked frozen only when explicitly stated in the corpus or in a future preregistration artifact.
threshold_policy.not_frozen_status: Threshold slot exists but cannot be used as a preregistered decision boundary yet.
threshold_policy.modification_log_rule: Any threshold change after date_frozen must be recorded before execution and invalidates prior preregistration unless explicitly versioned.

status_semantics.formalized_pending_preregistration: The prediction exists in the corpus and is structured here, but thresholds, datasets, and execution manifests are not yet frozen.
status_semantics.internal_support_only: The corpus reports internal support, but no external adjudication is claimed.
status_semantics.blocked: The prediction cannot be executed until a named missing artifact, rival, or protocol exists.
status_semantics.externally_adjudicated: Reserved for future use only after independent execution and decision records.
status_semantics.external_candidate_not_executed: The prediction has a non-framework-facing observable candidate, but no frozen runner, dataset, threshold, or decision record yet.
status_semantics.internal_synthetic_pilot_executed: A frozen internal synthetic pilot has executed with decision records, but no external adjudication or empirical validation is claimed.
status_semantics.clean_room_synthetic_executed: A seeded clean-room synthetic execution has run with negative controls and reviewer quarantine, but no empirical support or external adjudication is claimed.

predictions.observable: Certified class label and Qop geometry across implementations.
predictions.manipulation: Compare a cross-substrate pair with preserved invariant margins.
predictions.framework_prediction: The pair remains in the same operational class with epsilon-bounded Qop geometry under the admissible equivalence regime.
predictions.rival_prediction: A substrate-privilege rival predicts class divergence based on substrate label despite preserved structure.
predictions.support_condition: The two implementations preserve all registered invariant margins and remain class-equivalent under frozen geometry tolerance.
predictions.weakening_condition: Equivalence holds only after changing tolerance, using non-matched implementations, or ignoring an unresolved identity-margin ambiguity.
predictions.destruction_condition: Class divergence or Qop geometry mismatch appears despite verified preserved structure.

thresholds.name: geometry_tolerance_epsilon
thresholds.source: Paper 6 states epsilon-bounded geometry but does not freeze a numeric epsilon in this registry.
thresholds.rationale: Must be fixed before execution to avoid tolerance tuning.

predictions.epistemic_limit: Cross-substrate operational equivalence is not human equivalence or identity transfer.

predictions.observable: Class membership and Qop geometry before and after targeted rupture.
predictions.manipulation: Perform a one-invariant ablation while preserving comparable substrate and gross scale.
predictions.framework_prediction: Verified loss of a critical invariant causes certified class exit, contraction, or undefined Qop when the pre-ablation invariant headroom exceeds the registered ambiguity margin delta_amb. If the pre-ablation headroom is at or below delta_amb, the result is classified as boundary-ambiguous weakening rather than support.
predictions.rival_prediction: A complexity-only or gross-scale rival predicts little or no class-relevant change when complexity and scale are preserved.
predictions.support_condition: The targeted invariant loss is verified, the pre-ablation headroom exceeds the registered ambiguity margin delta_amb, sham/off-target controls do not produce the same pattern, and the class exits, contracts, or becomes undefined according to frozen rules.
predictions.weakening_condition: The result falls inside the pre-declared boundary-ambiguous margin, changes only under global degradation, or depends on nonselective damage that also affects matched controls.
predictions.destruction_condition: The system remains certified without downgrade after verified invariant loss outside the registered ambiguity margin.

thresholds.name: rho_rupture
thresholds.rationale: Minimum relative certification drop under invariant ablation.

predictions.epistemic_limit: No new empirical execution is implied by this registry entry.

predictions.manipulation: Compare a certified lower-scale system against a higher-scale baseline lacking the invariant package.
predictions.framework_prediction: The certified invariant-preserving system passes while the matched complexity-only baseline fails or remains undefined.
predictions.rival_prediction: A scale-only model predicts that higher complexity or activity should be sufficient for certification.
predictions.support_condition: The complexity-matched baseline fails under frozen certification while the invariant-preserving candidate passes.
predictions.weakening_condition: The baseline fails only because of poor implementation quality, non-matched scale, or an excluded artifact rather than missing invariants.
predictions.destruction_condition: A scale-only or activity-only control passes certification despite missing required invariants.

thresholds.name: complexity_match_tolerance
thresholds.source: Paper 5 defines surrogate families with theta_X, theta_Phi, theta_C but no numeric values are frozen here.
thresholds.rationale: The complexity match must be frozen before comparing against invariant-preserving candidates.

predictions.epistemic_limit: Internal support in the corpus must not be read as external matched-baseline validation.

predictions.manipulation: Place the system in a pass region and apply micro-perturbations inside the frozen tolerance.
predictions.framework_prediction: Response remains stable within predicted tolerance.
predictions.rival_prediction: A fragile-threshold rival predicts uncontrolled flips even inside the claimed pass region.
predictions.support_condition: The run remains inside tolerance across the preregistered perturbation panel.
predictions.weakening_condition: Stability holds only for cherry-picked perturbations or after threshold changes.
predictions.destruction_condition: Response falls outside tolerance in the frozen pass-region panel.

thresholds.name: pass_region_tolerance
thresholds.source: Paper 6 requires tolerance but does not freeze a numeric value here.
thresholds.rationale: Must be fixed before pass-region testing.

predictions.epistemic_limit: This is a boundary-behavior test, not a consciousness or phenomenality test.

predictions.manipulation: Place the system in a fail region and apply micro-perturbations inside the frozen tolerance.
predictions.rival_prediction: A tuning artifact may predict accidental recovery or pass behavior in fail-region cases.
predictions.support_condition: The run remains outside tolerance under the preregistered fail-region panel.
predictions.weakening_condition: Fail behavior depends on non-reproducible seeds or untracked local tuning.
predictions.destruction_condition: Response falls within tolerance in the frozen fail-region panel.

thresholds.name: fail_region_tolerance
thresholds.source: Paper 6 requires tolerance but does not freeze a numeric value here.
thresholds.rationale: Must be fixed before fail-region testing.

predictions.manipulation: Scan parameters across the critical regime with frozen step size and tolerance.
predictions.framework_prediction: The transition band is neither pass nor fail and occupies less than 10 percent of the scanned parameter space.
predictions.rival_prediction: An unfalsifiable or gerrymandered boundary model can absorb broad ambiguous regions as success.
predictions.support_condition: The ambiguous band is reproducibly below the frozen width threshold.
predictions.weakening_condition: The band is narrow only under favorable sampling or post-hoc scan boundaries.
predictions.destruction_condition: The band occupies more than 10 percent of the scanned parameter space or no transition is detected.
predictions.epistemic_limit: The 10 percent threshold is corpus-stated; scan design remains unfrozen.

predictions.observable: Continuity and fragmentation pattern under matched disturbance.
predictions.manipulation: Compare a rigid regime against a finite-mass or deformable regime under matched disturbance.
predictions.framework_prediction: The rigid regime keeps continuity while the limited or deformable regime fragments.
predictions.rival_prediction: A regime-agnostic rival predicts no differential continuity pattern.
predictions.support_condition: Rigid and deformable regimes show the preregistered differential response under matched disturbance.
predictions.weakening_condition: Differential response appears only under unmatched disturbance strength or unbalanced observability.
predictions.destruction_condition: No differential continuity pattern appears under matched disturbance.

thresholds.name: matched_disturbance_tolerance
thresholds.source: Not specified in current corpus text.
thresholds.rationale: Needed to prevent unmatched perturbation strength from explaining the result.

predictions.epistemic_limit: The result would support a structural regime claim, not phenomenal experience.

predictions.claim_family: Admissibility under tamper and sham controls
predictions.observable: Admissibility verdict under corrupted or malformed run artifacts.
predictions.manipulation: Inject hash corruption, malformed logs, or severe protocol violations.
predictions.framework_prediction: Tampered runs are discarded and never promoted to evidential support.
predictions.rival_prediction: A loose evaluation pipeline accepts tampered runs or treats them as weak support.
predictions.support_condition: Every preregistered tamper case is rejected or quarantined by the admissibility gate.
predictions.weakening_condition: Tamper is detected but downstream claim projection remains ambiguous or inconsistent.
predictions.destruction_condition: A tampered or malformed run is promoted to evidential support.

thresholds.name: tamper_acceptance_tolerance
thresholds.source: Paper 6 PRED-06 states tampered runs are discarded and never promoted.
thresholds.rationale: Any promoted tampered run destroys the admissibility claim.

predictions.epistemic_limit: This is an integrity/admissibility test, not evidence for consciousness.

predictions.observable: Class membership and geometry under perturbations inside certified margin budget delta_star(S).
predictions.manipulation: Apply perturbations inside the certified margin budget.
predictions.framework_prediction: Membership and geometry remain stable inside the certified budget.
predictions.rival_prediction: A fragile-threshold model flips class under sub-critical perturbations.
predictions.support_condition: Sub-critical perturbations preserve membership and geometry across the frozen perturbation panel.
predictions.weakening_condition: Stability appears only in a narrow or hand-selected subset of perturbations.
predictions.destruction_condition: Class flips under sub-critical admissible perturbations across otherwise stable positive cases.

thresholds.name: delta_star_budget
thresholds.source: Paper 5 defines delta_star(S) as min Delta(S); numeric execution values are not frozen here.
thresholds.rationale: Execution requires a measurement dictionary that computes each delta_j(S).

predictions.epistemic_limit: Approximate stability remains internal unless externally replicated.

predictions.observable: Recoverable non-trivial Qop class structure after full certification.
predictions.manipulation: Run the full certification schema on a system with all margins positive.
predictions.framework_prediction: Qop is non-empty and operationally well-defined.
predictions.rival_prediction: A purely formal or decoder-artifact account may pass certification while no non-trivial class is recoverable.
predictions.support_condition: A full certificate with positive margins yields a recoverable non-empty, non-trivial Qop structure.
predictions.weakening_condition: Qop is recoverable only under a decoder choice not justified by the certification bundle.
predictions.destruction_condition: Certification passes while no non-trivial operational class is recoverable.

thresholds.name: positive_margin_requirement
thresholds.source: Paper 5 defines Cop by positive satisfaction of all six invariants.
thresholds.rationale: Execution needs concrete margin estimators for each invariant.

predictions.epistemic_limit: Non-empty Qop is an operational class result, not phenomenal consciousness.

predictions.observable: Claim survival under latency or compute-budget stress.
predictions.manipulation: Exceed preregistered latency, compute, or admissibility budget limits.
predictions.framework_prediction: Strong operational claims are invalidated or downgraded.
predictions.rival_prediction: A metric-first pipeline keeps claims active after budget violation.
predictions.support_condition: Budget violation triggers the frozen invalidation or downgrade rule.
predictions.weakening_condition: Budget violation is detected but downgrade behavior is inconsistent or discretionary.
predictions.destruction_condition: Strong claims remain active after a preregistered budget violation.

thresholds.name: latency_compute_budget
thresholds.source: Paper 6 requires preregistered budget limits but this registry does not freeze values.
thresholds.rationale: Budget values must be bound to the specific execution environment before testing.

predictions.epistemic_limit: This is an admissibility and governance test.

predictions.claim_family: Legibility under noise and structured compression
predictions.observable: Separability and intervention fidelity as admissible noise/compression rises.
predictions.manipulation: Raise admissible noise or structured compression while preserving or breaking Ileg.
predictions.framework_prediction: Separability and intervention fidelity survive only while Ileg remains positive.
predictions.rival_prediction: A generic observability model predicts no specific dependence on Ileg.
predictions.support_condition: Legibility metrics remain within frozen bounds when Ileg is positive and fail/degrade when Ileg crosses its frozen boundary.
predictions.weakening_condition: Legibility changes are explained by decoder fragility unrelated to the registered Ileg clauses.
predictions.destruction_condition: Generic observability remains stable with no specific dependence on Ileg, or Ileg failure does not affect certification.

thresholds.name: legibility_margin_delta_leg
thresholds.source: Paper 5 defines L1-L6 clauses bounded by delta_leg(S); numeric execution values are not frozen here.
thresholds.rationale: Measurement dictionary must bind separability, noise robustness, intervention fidelity, false-positive rate, and compression distortion.

predictions.epistemic_limit: Legibility is an operational audit condition, not semantic transparency or phenomenality.

predictions.observable: Operational consciousness certification under destroyed integration and preserved complexity.
predictions.manipulation: Destroy integration while preserving complexity or gross activity.
predictions.framework_prediction: The system fails operational consciousness certification.
predictions.rival_prediction: A complexity-only rival predicts that preserved complexity should be sufficient for certification.
predictions.support_condition: The integration-destroyed, complexity-preserved system fails certification under frozen rules.
predictions.weakening_condition: Failure is confounded by gross collapse, non-matched complexity, or measurement loss unrelated to integration.
predictions.destruction_condition: The system passes certification despite verified loss of integration.

thresholds.name: integration_loss_boundary
thresholds.rationale: Minimum integration loss while preserving complexity.

predictions.epistemic_limit: This can falsify a complexity-only rival; it does not prove consciousness.

predictions.observable: Total-variation change in externally observed transition distributions after a targeted channel intervention, compared with sham and off-target interventions.
predictions.manipulation: Run a finite controlled transition system under a frozen baseline trace protocol, then apply a targeted perturbation to the declared identity-continuity channel while preserving trace length, state alphabet, and gross activity budget.
predictions.framework_prediction: If the QICN-linked identity-continuity channel is carrying non-trivial transition structure, the targeted intervention produces a selective transition-distribution shift larger than sham and off-target controls under the frozen selectivity ratio.
predictions.rival_prediction: A trace-memory or entropy-only rival predicts that transition-distribution shifts are explained by trace length, entropy, or buffer continuity and therefore should be matched by memory/entropy controls at equal or lower penalized loss.
predictions.support_condition: The targeted intervention produces a reproducible selectivity ratio above the frozen threshold, sham/off-target controls remain below threshold, and the trace-memory rival has higher penalized loss on the same external observable.
predictions.weakening_condition: The selective shift appears only under favorable seeds, unstable estimator choices, unmatched entropy, or post-hoc adjustment of the perturbation panel.
predictions.destruction_condition: The memory/entropy rival predicts the external transition-distribution observable at equal or lower penalized loss, or the targeted intervention fails to separate from sham/off-target controls under frozen rules.

thresholds.name: transition_selectivity_ratio
thresholds.unit: ratio of targeted total-variation shift to maximum sham/off-target shift
thresholds.rationale: A targeted intervention must produce at least twice the maximum sham/off-target TV shift to count as selective in the internal synthetic pilot.

thresholds.name: penalized_loss_alpha
thresholds.rationale: Small complexity penalty over trace-length-times-state-count normalization for the trace-memory rival in the internal synthetic pilot.

modification_log.reason: FCR v15-pilot freeze before committed pilot record.

thresholds.name: rival_loss_floor
thresholds.rationale: The rival must have non-trivial loss on the targeted observable before the pilot can record internal synthetic support.

modification_log.reason: FCR v15-pilot freeze before committed pilot record.

predictions.epistemic_limit: This is an external finite-trace prediction seed with one internal synthetic pilot. It can test a transition-selectivity claim on a toy-scale system, but it cannot prove consciousness, phenomenality, personal identity, or external adjudication of the full framework.
